title: We launched our own game: LapRadar League
caption: We launched our own racing game! Race 1: Yas Marina is open now. Phone or PC, cockpit or chase cam, right in the browser and free. Build your driver, set your time before next Monday and make the weekly podium. lapradar.com → LapRadar League #LapRadar #LapRadarLeague #racing #game #YasMarina

scenes.say: Race one: Yas Marina. Open now.
On your computer or phone, right in the browser.
Build your driver and your car.
Set your time before next Monday!
